body:
Founder real-time: 'IDUNA has abandoned pull requests bring them in fix the conflicts'. Merged claude/charming-wozniak-ya3uy3 (PR #18, forked 2026-09-25, 651 insertions/4 deletions vs its own fork point). Real conflicts: CHANGELOG.md (chronological merge), a stale go:embed dist bundle rename/delete conflict (resolved by deferring to a full rebuild at the end), and a genuine Go redeclaration: this PR's gltf_widget_test.go and the already-merged keyframe-animator PR's rig_test.go each independently defined a package-level near(a,b,...) test helper with different signatures -- git's line merge didn't conflict (non-overlapping hunks) but go vet caught it; renamed the glTF-side one to gltfNear. go build/vet/test all clean. GitHub auto-closed PR #18 as merged once pushed. commit IDUNA@796ff8b (final merge tip of a 3-PR integration).

⚓ ☃
title: Merged abandoned PR #18: glTF -> SHANKPIT widget importer bridge
